caption:
Your Gemini Managed Agents break without execution hooks.

Here's how Gemini Managed Agents handle tool execution hooks:
1. User Prompt — Raw task input enters the managed agent environment.
2. Gemini Agent — The model parses intent and generates structured tool execution plans.
3. Execution Hooks — Deterministic middleware intercepts generated tool calls before execution to sanitize arguments and enforce security bounds.
4. External Tools — Approved tool payloads are dispatched safely to external services.

When evaluating managed agent frameworks, deterministic tool validation matters more than sheer context length.

No autonomous magic — just structured state management and deterministic guardrails.
